frequency_question: How often do congressional majorities with declared intent successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval overcoming executive dynamics within the statutory review window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal joint resolutions of disapproval introduced and brought to a vote under the Atomic Energy Act or Arms Export Control Act review provisions where leadership actively whipped against an executive agreement. Excludes non-binding resolutions and failed committee motions.
